verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own Business SMS Booster gives the team a shared inbox for customer texts. That covers the team-visible texting part of the story. Nothing shows calls and texts threaded together under a contact record, and nothing shows shared notes. The CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot) would put that threading in another tool, so they are not credited, and the call-log API is only a developer building block. missing for 10: unified per-contact threading of calls and texts, contact-level notes, team-visible combined interaction history, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts thread under a contact with notes and history the whole team sees
